title: Obesity, morbid obesity and BMI
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's weight diagnosis and BMI, if reportable.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for weight management.

HPI
Pt is a 73-year-old female presenting for follow-up regarding weight. Pt reports difficulty adhering to previous caloric restrictions. She notes some joint pain but denies shortness of breath or chest pain. Pt is motivated to lose weight to improve mobility and overall health.

Medication List
Multivitamin daily
Glucosamine 500mg BID

Exam
Vitals: BP 138/88, HR 74, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, BMI 52.4.
Gen: Alert, cooperative, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Resp: Clear to auscultation, no wheezing.
MSK: Mild joint stiffness noted in bilateral knees.
Ext: No edema.

Assessment
1. Morbid obesity.
2. Joint stiffness.

Plan
Discussed weight management goals. Advised increased physical activity and caloric deficit. Referral provided to weight management program for structured support. Pt to f/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed, M. Okafor, PA-C, 05/12/2026
explanations: Morbid (severe) obesity documented by the provider: E66.01 (HCC 48).
BMI 52.x with a provider weight diagnosis: add Z68.43 (BMI 40 or more maps to HCC 48 on its own).

distractors.why: The provider documents morbid obesity: E66.01, not E66.9.
The BMI is documented and the provider diagnosed the weight condition: add the Z68 code.
